thread:
maria: AcmeMaps escalated — billing alerts (high-cost-per-token) fired repeatedly 03:11–03:14 UTC after metrics pipeline deploy. They report no real traffic spike, just phantom spikes in the 1m chart. Need a quick triage.

maria: Quick repro I did in staging:
1) Deploy metrics-rollup v2.3.7 at 03:10
2) Send single large-token request (~50k tokens) at 03:11
3) Watch dashboard 'cost-per-token (1m)' — it shows a sharp spike and alert fires.

maria: Query we used:
```sql
SELECT avg(cost_per_token) FROM tokens WHERE service='acme' GROUP BY time(1m)
```

maria: Logs excerpt from rollup: 
```text
2024-04-10T03:10:35Z metrics-rollup: bucketize start align=false
2024-04-10T03:10:36Z metrics-rollup: wrote partial bucket /metrics/1m/172 count=1 sum=50000
```

jake: looks like a bucketization/alignment issue. last deploy changed default align -> false to avoid shifting windows, but partial buckets are being emitted. with sample_count=1 the avg explodes and relative-thresholds trip. :eyes:

sam: can you paste rollup config from prod? if partial buckets are `emit` we should exclude them for percent-based thresholds or require minimum samples.

ana (correction): ana: prod rollup config snippet: 
```yaml
rollup:
  period: 60 # seconds
  align: false
  partial_policy: "emit"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy finished: metrics-rollup v2.3.7 -> prod at 2024-04-10T03:09:58Z

jake: short-term mitigation: change alert evaluation to require `sample_count >= 3` or switch rollup `align: true` to avoid mixing boundaries. long-term: make threshold evaluator ignore partial-emitted buckets for relative comparisons.

maria: customer is sensitive because billing flagged this — can eng-sre priority this? I can repro reliably in staging and provide traces.

sam: I'm putting together a quick patch to skip buckets where sample_count < 2 in the threshold service. should have a PR in ~30m. will include test for edge-aligned timestamps.

jake: i'll review. also add telemetry: count of partial-buckets used in eval so we can alert internally if this recurs.

ana (ana): marking incident P2 and looping in billing ops. keeping customer updated.

maria: thanks — will keep thread updated with customer notes and staging repro link.
